Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full recent-transactions payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Your recent transactions","accountLabel":"Everyday Checking ••1234","transactions":[{"id":"txn-1","merchant":"Whole Foods Market","date":"2026-08-09","amount":-84.23,"currency":"USD","category":"Groceries","status":"Posted"},{"id":"txn-2","merchant":"Delta Air Lines","date":"2026-08-07","amount":-412.60,"currency":"USD","category":"Travel","status":"Posted"},{"id":"txn-3","merchant":"Payroll Deposit","date":"2026-08-06","amount":2450.00,"currency":"USD","category":"Income","status":"Posted"},{"id":"txn-4","merchant":"Corner Bistro","date":"2026-08-05","amount":-56.80,"currency":"USD","category":"Dining","status":"Pending","disputable":false}],"disputeText":"Dispute this charge"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): the heading shown above the list. - 'accountLabel' (string, optional): the account these transactions belong to, e.g. 'Everyday Checking ••1234'. - 'transactions' (array, REQUIRED, at least one object): each MUST have 'id' (string, unique, sent back when the customer disputes it), 'merchant' (string), 'date' (string, ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'), and 'amount' (number; NEGATIVE for money out/debits, POSITIVE for money in/credits). Optional per transaction: 'currency' (ISO code string, defaults to 'USD'), 'category' (string; one of 'Groceries','Dining','Travel','Shopping','Bills','Transfer','Income','Other' — drives the row icon), 'status' (string, e.g. 'Posted' or 'Pending'; 'Pending' shows a pill), and 'disputable' (boolean; set false to show the row but prevent the customer from selecting it — e.g. income or already-disputed items). - 'disputeText' (string, optional): the confirm-button label; defaults to 'Dispute this charge'. Never emit an empty 'transactions' array. Use the customer's real transactions from context; if none are known, ask the customer rather than inventing charges. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
